verdict.rationale: Extend's extraction response format documents per-field citations that "point back to the exact spot on the page", alongside per-field confidence scores. Citations are also a listed product feature, and multifile extraction documents citations and file provenance. Together these deliver the core of the story: field-level provenance that agents can cite and humans can verify. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that citations include page number, bounding-box coordinates and the source text snippet (only implied by "exact spot on the page"), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the provenance is accurate.
